calibration_method: Joint logistic intercept and slope on logits clipped at 1e-6 and 1-1e-6. Router uses recovered routed positive rate only. 95% Wald intervals condition on these scores. One-dimensional quasi-separation, low class counts, nonconvergence and unstable information disable the estimate. Gate estimates are ordered pooled outer training then inner subsets 0,1,2. Magnitude on pooled rows and matching sign in two supported subsets activate that fold only.
commit5_expansion: Pending the black-box experiment in Commit 5.

handoff.next: Evaluate the registered global Linear Arbiter first. Activate route-specific fits only in eligible partitions. Assess normalization against the unchanged formula at matched coverage. Agreement and unique wins describe complementarity; neither measures the loss after removing a voter.

abstention.search: exact: every distinct training confidence value; abstain where confidence < cut (PR 36 F30)
abstention.selected_by: F2 on train OOF retained rows, exact search over distinct weighted confidences, coverage ≥ 50%

accepted.score: weighted probability (a ranking score, not a calibrated probability)

interpretation: Sole correct compares all active voters; a lone dissent requires three votes. Router veto cost compares reversing the router alone on double-negative Pass 2 rows. Negative ceiling holds votes, weights and positive evidence fixed and takes negative LR/EBM probabilities to zero. A positive side above the ceiling cannot be overturned by these voters. No explicit clipping operation is implied. Bound means use every row in the named stratum. The ranking score is separate from signed decision evidence. Matched flag counts exclude whole boundary ties when an exact contrast is unavailable. Global summaries describe frozen rows only.
joint_corners: Pending the two registered one-factor inner-loss gains in Commit 4.
limitations: Nested Stage 4 only: upstream OOF inputs are fixed. Stage 2/3 inputs of outer-training rows come from producers fitted with outer-evaluation labels; Stage 1 (ten folds) producers of evaluation rows saw other evaluation rows. Upstream nested selection is PR 44.
Random-split, training-only evidence: target-derived features can use later contacts' labels and MLP early stopping shared encoder fitting (PR 42). Forward-in-time claims need PR 49.
Conditional row uncertainty excludes upstream refitting; exploratory counts do not identify causal effects.
registered_conditions: Apply diagnostic triggers independently inside each outer training partition using inner OOF evidence. Global Commit 3 summaries are descriptive. Exclude outer labels and predictions from activation. For route reliability, require >=20 per class in each compared state and absolute between-state voter calibration slope difference >=0.5 with the same ordering in at least two of three inner folds. Only then enable shrunk route coefficients. Enable four joint formula corners only if both a one-factor recall change and a one-factor alpha change improve inner loss by >=0.005 each. Enable one cross-fitted rule-evidence ablation only if fit-sample minus cross-fitted precision >=0.05 at >=100 routed observations in two inner folds. Unavailable leakage-safe evidence: defer that ablation; no upstream refit during screening.
rule_evidence: Unresolved. Fold-specific rule sets and independent cross-fitted per-rule precision are absent from the verified streams. Defer the ablation.
